Frequently Asked Questions

What is a 'qualified lead'?

A qualified lead is a prospective customer who has a clear need for your service, has the budget to purchase, and has submitted their contact details indicating interest.

How do you capture leads online?

We use targeted ads, optimized landing pages, simplified contact forms, click-to-call buttons, and lead magnets (like free quotes or brochures) to capture customer details.
